chunks: And from him, from his father, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Fazalah, from Aban and Muawiya ibn Wahb, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

When you stand for the prayer, say: O Allah! I present Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) before my need, and I turn to You through him, so make me esteemed through Him in Your presence in this world and the Hereafter, and of those who are brought near. Make my prayer acceptable through him, and my sin forgiven through him, and my supplication answered through him. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when standing for prayer according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded in Al-Kafi, emphasizes the Shia concept of *tawassul* by positioning the Prophet Muhammad as an intercessor to secure acceptance of prayer and forgiveness. It reflects the theological belief that spiritual proximity (*wajh*) to God is achieved through the Prophet, linking earthly worship with eternal elevation among the *muqarrabin* (those brought near to God).

en.hubeali:
And from him, from his father, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Aban and Muawiya Bin Wahab who both said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘When you stand to the Salāt, so say, ‘O Allahazwj! I consider Muhammadsaww in front of me in Yourazwj Presence along with me wishes and needs and I turn to You through themasws. therefore Make it for me a valid reason in Yourazwj Presence, in the world and in the Hereafter, to be of the ones of proximity. Make my Salāt to be Acceptable through himsaww, and my sins to be Forgiven through himsaww, and my supplications to be Answered through himsaww, Youazwj are the Forgiver, Merciful’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by his father from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Aban and Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

when you stand up for Salah (prayer), say this: ‘O Allah, I consider Muhammad, O Allah grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, to be in front of me in Your presence along with my wishes and needs and I turn to You through him. For the sake of his position before You, grant me honor in this and the next world and include me among those near You. Make my Salah (prayer) accepted through him, my sins forgiven and my prayer and wishes granted. You are forgiving and merciful.’””
